name: JAC Sengoku ages probe: era length, era score per player at every era change (previous-era breakdown, all 22), Lua API surface (read only, Japan 15 km, Takeda human)

steps.code:
local out = {}
local pats = {'Era','Moment','Score','Commemor','Age','Property','Modifier','Boost','Dedic','Threshold','Loyalty'}
local function hit(k) for _, p in ipairs(pats) do if string.find(k, p, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
local function list(label, obj)
  local names = {}
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local mt = getmetatable(obj)
    local src = mt and mt.__index
    if type(src) ~= 'table' then src = obj end
    if type(src) == 'table' then
      for k, _ in pairs(src) do if type(k) == 'string' and hit(k) then names[#names+1] = k end end
    end
  end)
  table.sort(names)
  out[#out+1] = label .. (ok and '' or (' ERR:' .. tostring(err))) .. ' [' .. #names .. ']: ' .. table.concat(names, ',')
end
list('Game', Game)
list('Eras', Game.GetEras())
list('HistoryManager', Game.GetHistoryManager())
list('Player', Players[0])
list('PlayerCulture', Players[0]:GetCulture())
list('PlayerTechs', Players[0]:GetTechs())
return table.concat(out, '\n')

local chunk = 0
local eras = Game.GetEras()
local turn = Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()
local eraStart = eras:GetCurrentEraStartTurn()
if eraStart > turn then error('era start ' .. eraStart .. ' is after turn ' .. turn) end
local changed = chunk > 0 and eraStart > turn - chunk
local out = {'turn=' .. turn .. ' era=' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEra()) .. ' final=' .. tostring(eras:GetFinalEra()) .. ' eraStart=' .. eraStart .. ' changedSinceLast=' .. tostring(changed) .. ' minEnd=' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEraMinimumEndTurn()) .. ' maxEnd=' .. tostring(eras:GetCurrentEraMaximumEndTurn()) .. ' countdown=' .. tostring(eras:GetNextEraCountdown())}
local function flat(list) local t, sum = {}, 0; for _, src in ipairs(list) do for k, v in pairs(src) do t[#t+1] = tostring(k) .. '=' .. tostring(v); sum = sum + v end end; table.sort(t); return sum, table.concat(t, ';') end
local alive = 0
for pid = 0, 21 do
  local p = Players[pid]
  local civ = tostring(PlayerConfigurations[pid]:GetCivilizationTypeName())
  if p and p:IsAlive() then
    alive = alive + 1
    local cur, curSrc = flat(eras:GetPlayerCurrentEraScoreBreakdown(pid))
    local prev, prevSrc = flat(eras:GetPlayerPreviousEraScoreBreakdown(pid))
    out[#out+1] = 'p' .. pid .. ' ' .. civ .. ' cities=' .. p:GetCities():GetCount() .. ' score=' .. tostring(eras:GetPlayerCurrentScore(pid)) .. ' base=' .. tostring(eras:GetPlayerThresholdBaseline(pid)) .. ' golden>=' .. tostring(eras:GetPlayerGoldenAgeThreshold(pid)) .. ' dark>=' .. tostring(eras:GetPlayerDarkAgeThreshold(pid)) .. ' G=' .. tostring(eras:HasGoldenAge(pid)) .. ' D=' .. tostring(eras:HasDarkAge(pid)) .. ' H=' .. tostring(eras:HasHeroicGoldenAge(pid)) .. ' cur=' .. cur .. '{' .. curSrc .. '} prevEra=' .. prev .. '{' .. prevSrc .. '}'
  else
    out[#out+1] = 'p' .. pid .. ' ' .. civ .. ' dead'
  end
end
if alive ~= #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors() then error('listed ' .. alive .. ' alive players, engine reports ' .. #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) end
return table.concat(out, '\n')

local out = {}
local hm = Game.GetHistoryManager()
for pid = 0, 21 do
  local counts, order = {}, {}
  for _, m in ipairs(hm:GetAllMomentsData(pid, 0)) do
    local info = GameInfo.Moments[m.Type]
    local key = (info and info.MomentType or tostring(m.Type)) .. '@era' .. tostring(m.GameEra)
    if not counts[key] then counts[key] = {n = 0, s = 0}; order[#order+1] = key end
    counts[key].n = counts[key].n + 1
    counts[key].s = counts[key].s + (m.EraScore or 0)
  end
  local t = {}
  for _, key in ipairs(order) do t[#t+1] = key .. ' x' .. counts[key].n .. ' (+' .. counts[key].s .. ')' end
  out[#out+1] = 'p' .. pid .. ' moments: ' .. table.concat(t, ', ')
end
return table.concat(out, '\n')
